LisBon Signal Infrastructure (LSI)

Know what the financial records really say.

Discuss a deployment↗See how it works ↓

LSI validates financial records, flags anomalies or possible tampering, and produces structured signals on income, obligations, expenses, cash flow, account stability and document integrity.

Who it is for

Banks, lenders, fintechs and teams that need reliable signals from financial records.

LSI validates records, flags anomalies or possible integrity issues and produces structured signals for the decision workflow.
